name: Napa cabbage
description: Sweet crinkly cabbage of Chinese soups and stir-fries.

ayurveda.note: Not classical; inferred from cabbage family.

histamine.note: Fresh is safe; kimchi form is a 3.

ref.as: celery cabbage, napa cabbage (Brassica rapa subsp. pekinensis)

nutrition.highlight: sweeter and wetter than green cabbage

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
